description:
Job Purpose
* Build the exclusive medicine portfolio as a brand owner: source, negotiate and launch exclusive batch-cut products with manufacturers and contract partners (focus on local pharma), taking each product through the 7-stage, 5-gate journey from brief to launch and lifecycle across chain stores, local pharmacies and clinics.
* Deliver the 2027 commitment: Exclusive Medicine Sales & Commercial Margin.
Main Responsibilities
1. Pipeline and product briefs
* Write a one-page brief per focus-list molecule: customer need, type, target shelf and purchase price, 3-year volume by channel, must-haves.
* Run the project portfolio by stage, next gate and numbers, updated weekly.
2. Domestic sourcing and batch-cut products
* With Regulatory & Quality, work with local factories and contract partners to find ≥ 3 candidates per molecule, compared with imported options
* Send RFQs with yearly volume for all three channels; collect GMP, registration, stability and capacity data for Gate 1
3. Exclusive partner negotiation
* With Trading, negotiate in order: unit price, MOQ phasing, exclusivity scope, launch support, back margin, risk terms
* Log every offer in the quotation tracker; compare complete offers only, using the six checks and the 30/30/20/20 scorecard
4. Business case and project sign-off
* Prepare the one-page launch approval: partner and scorecard, group-level business case (sales, margin gain, ≥ 60% retained), terms, launch plan and budget, risks
* Recommend launch only when group margin lifts ≥ 10 points; large projects (≈ 10 bn/year) go to the CEO
5. Contract and production readiness
* Coordinate master agreement and product schedule with Trading and Legal: exclusivity, volume, 12–24 month price lock, quality, supply, returns, marketing, exit
* Track first order and product setup (item code, price, P&L line, store allocation, combokit); ≥ 8 weeks of stock before launch
6. Multi-channel launch
* Run a 4-week pilot in 50–100 stores, review, then roll out to the chain, local pharmacies and clinics
* Coordinate training, the new incentive and marketing; enforce the rule that a customer asking for a brand gets that brand
7. Review and lifecycle
* Review each launch at 30/60/90 days on the group scorecard; propose scale, fix (60 days) or exit
* Review the 26 existing exclusives in Q1 2027 (keep, fix, exit); agree annual brand plans and JBPs with partners, reviewed quarterly
8. Reporting, coordination and people
* Lead the weekly working session; prepare inputs for gate meetings, the monthly exclusive review and CEO update; report shelf checks before margin
* Manage, assign work to and develop the Exclusive Medicine Specialist
requirements_text:
Education : Bachelor’s degree or above
Professional major : Pharmacy degree preferred. Non-pharmacy graduates (Business, Economics, Chemistry, Biology...) need 4–5+ years of experience below
Relevant Experience :
- At least 3 years (pharmacists) or 4–5+ years (other majors) at pharma companies, preferably local pharma
- Experience in sourcing, hospital tender and pharmacy channels; or selling batch-cut deals to pharmacies, chains and distributors
- Experience negotiating and launching exclusive batch-cut products with manufacturers and contract partners
Professional Competencies :
- Knowledge of drug registration, GMP standards, the Law on Pharmacy and medicine advertising rules
- Commercial negotiation: price, MOQ, exclusivity, rebates/back margin, supply and return terms
- Commercial acumen: business cases, front/back margin, category P&L
Management & Leadership Competencies:
- Stage-gate project management, on time
- Cross-functional influence without authority; long-term partner relationships
- Coach, assign work to, and follow up with team member
Foreign Language Proficiency : Good English: technical dossiers, emails and meetings with foreign partners
Computer Skills: Proficient in Excel (Pivot, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS), PowerPoint, Word
Additional Notes
- Integrity and compliance: no forced switching, no prescription-linked payments to doctors
- Handles target pressure; willing to travel to factories and partners
